findings.passage: “To now erase those guardrails is not progress — it’s amnesia,” Young said. “And amnesia, in the face of loss, is dangerous. Waiting periods work.”
findings.note: Quoted in a newspaper column on the HB 133 floor debate; he argues for keeping the age limit and for waiting periods.

findings.motion: Floor amendment 666985 offered by Rep. Young (failed)
findings.note: He filed an amendment to HB 133 keeping the buying age at 21 and adding a 7-day wait before dealers hand over a long gun to a 18-to-20-year-old, even if a background check has cleared. The bill page lists it as failed.
